description: This file defines a TinyMCE plugin for context menus, including plugin initialization, event handling, and context menu rendering.

classes.name: TinyMCE_ContextMenu
classes.description: Class representing the context menu UI, handling item addition, display, and hiding.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information such as name, author, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes the context menu plugin for a specific editor instance, setting up event handlers.

methods.name: _onContextMenu
methods.description: Handles the right-click event to determine the context and show the menu.

methods.name: _showContextMenu
methods.description: Displays the context menu at the specified position based on the event and target element.

methods.name: _commandHandler
methods.description: Executes commands based on menu item selection and manages menu visibility.
